name: University of Toronto
header:
University of Toronto
Canada · Mathematics MSc / direct-entry PhD / PhD
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 16. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Do not use undergraduate Toronto deadlines for math graduate applications.
• Entering referee names immediately sends requests.
• US F-1 status is not a Canadian study permit: international OGS eligibility is not automatic.
• Kamnitzer is currently McGill despite appearing in an older Toronto handbook.
• Ananth Shankar is at Northwestern, as confirmed by Toronto's November 2026 seminar announcement; do
not confuse him with Toronto's Arul Shankar. Henry Kim, Stephen Kudla and Kumar Murty are now included
with individual publication evidence.

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
SGS funded-cohort PhD base CAD 40,000/year inclusive of tuition, effective Fall 2025. 2025-26 math handbook
gives MSc CAD 24,250 plus tuition/fees (includes about 180 TA hours), and PhD CAD 40,000 inclusive of fees
with math TA enhancement. 2027 dollar offer not confirmed. [s7] [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Full-time MSc: 1 year; ordinary PhD: 4; direct PhD: 5. [s8]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department page guarantees full-time admitted master's/doctoral students without excluding internationals;
confirm international tuition/UHIP components in offer. OGS international category requires Canadian study
permit already effective at deadline. [s8] [s10]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Academic progress, good standing and satisfactory TA work; package combines fellowships, TA and other
funds. Part-time students not funded. [s8]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
OGS requires separate application to each intended unit. Ordinary departmental package linked to admission.
[s8] [s10]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
OGS: CAD 5,000/session, CAD 10,000 or 15,000 over two/three sessions. Department scholarships and external
awards may form part of funding rather than add dollar-for-dollar. [s8] [s10]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
CAD 135 for September 2027 entry; nonrefundable and nontransferable. Visa/Mastercard credit accepted; not
their debit cards. Supplementary program fee, if any, must be checked. [s4]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
SGS FAQ says no waiver, deferral or refund. No mathematics-specific exception verified. [s4]

Hodge theory, periods, Shimura varieties and arithmetic geometry. [s14]

Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.

Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.

Arithmetic/algebraic geometry of moduli spaces, Higgs bundles and local systems, p-adic integration, BPS
invariants and K-theory. [s24] [s25] [qa1] [qa4]

bibliography. Direct arXiv opening failed; official search extract supplied metadata.

Derived/classical algebraic geometry, motivic cohomology, algebraic K-theory, cycles, birational invariants and
motivic homotopy theory. [s22] [s23] [qa2]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
